headline: The book still leans constructive on AI infrastructure, but many leaders are overbought enough that same-day conviction is capped and risk management matters more than fresh chasing.

today.thesis: Premarket is modestly green, semicap peers are mostly green, and Mytutopia VEL5 remains positive at +5.5. But Δ1 turned negative at -1.6, yesterday was a red session, and prior calibration says next-day continuation after big narrative bursts is easy to overcall. Base case: constructive but choppy session.

30d.thesis: The earnings package remains strong, the no-China-compute guide already embeds a major constraint, and the newest Microsoft/NemoClaw announcements widen the monetization surface. 1y.thesis: The one-year view stays bullish because NVIDIA still has the deepest integrated hardware/software moat in the category, very large cash generation, a buyback backstop, and a roadmap spanning cloud, enterprise workstations, industrial agents, and physical AI. The recovered technical regime lowers the odds that the long-duration thesis is being set on a broken tape.

1y.thesis: One year out, the base case is still that Micron has entered a structurally higher earnings regime because AI has recast memory and storage as strategic bottlenecks.
